jobs.title: Chef de Partie - Gardemanger (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Chef de Partie - Gardemanger (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Start: 2026-10-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## Your mission:
To strengthen our kitchen team, we are looking for a passionate Chef de Partie – Gardemanger (f/m/d) who delivers top quality to the plate with passion, precision, and a flair for cold culinary artistry.
• Section Ownership: You lead the gardemanger section independently, preparing exquisite cold starters, salads, creative carpaccios, tartares, terrines, and sophisticated canapés to the highest standard (16 GaultMillau points).

• Flawless Mise en Place: You organise your section with structure, precision, and a sharp eye for detail – from handling delicate raw produce and fresh herbs through to the final, immaculate presentation at the pass during service.

• Creative Input: You actively contribute your own ideas for seasonal cold dishes, plating concepts, and innovative culinary techniques to the kitchen brigade.

• Quality & Efficiency: You ensure a smooth service flow at the cold station and maintain exemplary hygiene, cold-chain, and HACCP standards at all times.

• Team Spirit & Mentorship: You provide inspiring leadership to Commis de Cuisine and apprentices on your section, fostering a respectful and encouraging work environment.

## This is you:
• Solid Foundation: Completed professional chef training and several years of experience in fine dining or luxury gastronomy, ideally with specific exposure to the gardemanger station.

• Passion for Produce: Deep knowledge of fresh raw ingredients, cold preparation techniques, and seasoning, paired with a strong commitment to premium quality and aesthetics.

• Precision under Pressure: A calm demeanor, composure, and sharp focus, even during peak service hours when timing is critical.

• Personality: High personal standards of quality, a true team-player mindset, resilience, and a genuine passion for high-end gastronomy.

• Languages: Must-Have: Italian. Ideally, good knowledge of English or German.
What You Can Expect from Us:
• Shape World-Class Gastronomy: Work within one of the most prestigious kitchen brigades in the Swiss Alps.

• Room for Growth: Tailored professional development opportunities and career advancement prospects within the Kulm Group.

• Attractive Living Environment: Work and live in the breathtaking mountain landscape of the Engadin, featuring attractive staff benefits and employee accommodation.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

## This is what you move with us
Shape the digital future of two of the most renowned hotels in the Swiss Alps – the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. As a Digital Marketing Executive, you will support our CRM & Digital Platforms Manager in maintaining, optimizing, and bringing the Kulm Group’s digital ecosystem to life for our guests at the highest level.Your Role & Responsibilities:
• Website & Platform Management: Maintain and update our websites      (front-end & CMS), manage content such as packages and events, support      SEO hygiene, and ensure a seamless user journey – from inspiration to the      booking engine.

• Digital Asset Management: Actively manage our Bynder system,      organize and tag visual assets, and coordinate photoshoots from      preparation to final asset handover.

• Reporting & Performance: Support the consolidation and      preparation of data for monthly performance reports.

• Team Coordination: Provide administrative support to the      Brand and Commercial team, prepare meetings, and ensure smooth      cross-departmental workflows.

## This is you
• Education: Successfully completed university degree (Bachelor) with a focus      on marketing, digital media, business administration, or a comparable      qualification.

• Experience: Initial practical experience in digital marketing, website      management, or online platform administration; basic knowledge of CMS      systems (and ideally HTML) is an advantage.

• Working Style: A structured, precise, and reliable      hands-on mentality with an exceptional eye for detail and brand      aesthetics.

• Competencies: Enthusiasm for digital user      experiences, strong organizational skills, and the ability to coordinate      multiple tasks in parallel and toward clear goals.

• Languages: Excellent written and spoken English skills; German and Italian      language skills are a strong asset.
What You Can Expect from Us:
• An Exclusive Environment: Work at the exciting intersection of      luxury hospitality and digital communication across two world-famous top      hotels.

• Room to Grow: A diverse range of responsibilities      with plenty of room for personal initiative and professional development      within the Kulm Group.

jobs.description:
Executive Assistant Manager - Rooms Division (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-08-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
Working in direct collaboration with the General Management, you bear overall responsibility for the Rooms Division and act as the driving force for quality and innovation:
• Strategic Leadership: You lead and inspire a team of approximately 80–120 employees through your direct reports (Front Office, Concierge, Reservations, Housekeeping, and Laundry).

• Guest Journey & Quality: You are responsible for the seamless implementation of Forbes and 5-star excellence standards. You don’t just analyze guest feedback; you transform it into tangible service innovations.

• Commercial Mindset: In close coordination with Revenue Management, Sales, and Marketing, you optimize occupancy and ADR. You are responsible for budget planning, forecasting, and cost control (labor and operating expenses) with a focus on maximum profitability.

• Process Pioneer: You drive digital transformation and optimize internal SOPs to minimize friction and maximize the time dedicated to the guest.

• Training: Constant training and continuous development of the teams.

• Host Mentality: You maintain a strong presence in the lobby, cultivate relationships with our discerning regular guests, and master complex complaint management with composure and charm.

## This is you
We are seeking an established leadership personality who thrives on complexity and views excellence as a way of life.
• Experience: You have completed a degree or vocational training in luxury hospitality and possess several years of leadership experience in a comparable position within the international 5-star hotel industry.

• Linguistic Proficiency: You are business fluent in both German and English. Due to our location and team structure, Italian is considered a very significant advantage.

• Coach & Mentor: You lead through inspiration rather than hierarchy. You find joy in developing talent and coaching fellow managers.

• Digital Affinity: You are confident in using modern PMS systems and have a passion for co-designing efficient digital processes.

• Demeanor: You embody the values of the Kulm Hotel—discreet, precise, resilient, and always acting as a natural role model.
Why the Kulm Group?
• Creative Freedom: A position of absolute trust with direct reporting to the General Manager and the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our properties, both humanly and professionally.

• Appreciation: An environment that values your experience in people management and gives you the space to establish modern, world-class leadership approaches.

• Exclusivity: Working at one of the world’s premier addresses within a team that places a high value on cohesion and mutual support.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.description:
F&B Administrative Assistant (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-12-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
In this versatile key position, you are the “Enabler” of our entire F&B division. You bridge the gap between administrative precision, cutting-edge hospitality technology, and front-of-house operations. You ensure that technical processes run flawlessly in the background while proactively supporting the F&B management in their daily business.Your Mission - Where Culinary Delight meets Logistics:
• Reservation Management: You are the primary point of contact for reservations (on-site, phone, email) via our software for all hotel outlets.

• Menu Design & Coordination: In close collaboration with the kitchen, marketing, and restaurant management, you coordinate and update our menus via “Ai-web-to-print.”

• Daily Operations: During the season, you create daily half-board menus, staff menus, and buffet labeling using “Ai-web-to-print” and “Viewneo.”

• Guest Experiences: You process individual guest requests for aperitifs or birthdays, ensuring that "extra touch" that defines our service.

• Amenity Management: Coordinate guest amenities with the Front Office and Room Service, including payment processing via “Saferpay” and “Opera.”

• Front-Line Support: When needed, you actively support our team directly in service, staying close to our guests.

• Quality Ambassador: You ensure compliance with the highest standards (LQA and Forbes Travel Guide) and professionally handle guest feedback and complaints.

• Administrative Excellence: Preparation of corporate invoices and general correspondence (office share approx. 80–90%).

## This is you
• Foundation: Completed hotel or commercial apprenticeship, as well as professional experience in a similar role, ideally within the luxury hospitality industry.

• Linguistic Excellence: Business fluent in German and English (written and spoken). Italian is a significant asset.

• IT Proficiency: Confident handling of MS Office and hotel systems (e.g., Opera Cloud).

• Personality: You are an organizational talent with absolute reliability and discretion. You remain calm and solution-oriented, even under high pressure.

• Host Mindset: You communicate at the highest service level, possess a poised appearance, and apply a “hands-on” mentality when it counts.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Senior Events Planning Manager (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-10-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations - across two of the most distinguished houses in Switzerland. As Events Planning Manager, you guide the entire planning journey from proposal through to operational handover, ensuring that every event is accurately planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina.Your Mission:
• End-to-End Event Planning: From the qualified enquiry through proposal and contract to the operational handover - including accommodation, meeting rooms, catering, technical requirements and personal guest preferences.

• Client Experience: You guide your clients through every stage of the planning process: briefings, site inspections, amendments and professional follow-up - always prompt, polished and personalised.

• Administrative Excellence: Preparation of contracts, confirmations, function sheets and Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), maintenance of all event files in PMS and CRM, and monitoring of deposits and payment schedules.

• Operational Interface: You lead the internal event planning meetings and liaise closely with Banqueting, Kitchen, Rooms Division, Reservations, Revenue Management and Front Office across both hotels.

• Leadership & Development: You lead and coach our Events Coordinator(s) day to day, set priorities and establish shared planning standards, templates and processes.

• Room to Shape: You play an active part in building the new integrated Events organisation of the Kulm Group and develop best practices for both hotels.

## This is you
• Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in hospitality, Events Management or Business Administration and at least three years of experience in hotel events, conference services or event planning, ideally covering meetings, incentives, weddings and private celebrations in the luxury segment.

• Organisational Talent: Outstanding attention to detail, a sure instinct for priorities and the ability to manage several projects simultaneously with composure.

• Process & Systems Knowledge: Confident command of PMS, CRM and event management systems, along with excellent Microsoft Office 365 skills.

• Personality: Dependable, solution-oriented and calm under pressure; you build lasting relationships with clients and with every operational department.

• Language Skills: Fluent and stylistically assured German and English, written and spoken; further languages are a plus.

• Start: October or by agreement.
If you would like to shape the future of Events at the Kulm Group, we look forward to receiving your full application.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.description:
Sous Chef Main Kitchen | 16 GaultMillau Points (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-02-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
Where passion meets perfection: In our main kitchen, we create culinary experiences at a 16 GaultMillau points level. We are seeking an experienced Sous Chef (m/f/d) to act as the trusted right hand to our Executive Chef, helping lead a highly skilled brigade and delivering excellence to every plate, day after day..
• Executive Right Hand: Supporting the Executive Chef in daily organization, planning, menu creation, and brigade leadership.

• Deputising Leadership: Serving as the Executive Chef’s primary deputy in their absence—taking full operational ownership with confidence and authority.

• Operational Excellence: Shared responsibility for smooth kitchen operations across all services—from extensive breakfast offerings to fine dining and gala dinners.

• Quality Assurance: Ensuring the highest presentation and flavor standards—your eye for detail guarantees a 16-point experience for every guest.

• Hygiene & Efficiency: Maintaining strict HACCP and safety standards, as well as responsible food cost and equipment management.

• Mentorship & Culture: Inspiring, guiding, and developing Commis de Cuisine and Chefs de Partie within a respectful, high-performing environment.

## This is you
• Qualifications: Completed professional culinary training (EFZ or international equivalent).

• Experience: Proven track record with several years of experience in senior positions (experienced Chef de Partie or Junior Sous Chef) within high-end gourmet gastronomy or a 5-star hotel setting (ideally at 15+ GaultMillau / Michelin star level).

• Leadership & Mindset: Strong leadership skills, high stress tolerance, cost awareness, and the ability to motivate a large brigade under pressure.

• Product Knowledge: Passion for premium produce, precision techniques, and continuous culinary innovation.

• Languages (Essential): Fluent in Italian, paired with good knowledge of English or German.
What we offer
• Shape World-Class Gastronomy: Work alongside an elite culinary brigade in one of the most prestigious grand hotels in the Swiss Alps.

• Growth: Tailored career advancement opportunities within the Kulm Group.

• Quality Living: Live and work in the Engadin valley, complete with staff accommodation, subsidized meals, and extensive group perks.
Start Date: Immediately or by mutual agreement.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.
